group: AI 基础设施与平台公司

questions.question: 实现一个线程安全的批处理 logger：多个生产者线程调用 log(msg)；后台线程每秒或批量满时，将最多 100 条消息成批刷出。
questions.questionEn: Implement a thread-safe batching logger: many producer threads call log(msg); a background thread flushes batches of up to 100 messages every second or when full.

questions.question: 你有一个数十亿事件的流，需要在内存受限的前提下求出出现频率最高的 top-K 个 key。精确解不可能做到：你会怎么做？
questions.questionEn: You have a stream of billions of events and need the top-K most frequent keys with bounded memory. Exact is impossible: what do you do?

questions.question: 给定以 CIDR 块表示的白名单 IP 段以及显式的拒绝网段，实现高效的 is_allowed(ip)，要能支撑每秒数百万次校验。
questions.questionEn: Given allowed IP ranges as CIDR blocks plus explicit deny ranges, implement is_allowed(ip) efficiently for millions of checks per second.

questions.question: 一个 Spark 作业把 2 TB 的事实表与 50 GB 的维表做 join，其中一个 straggler task 的运行时间是其余任务的 100 倍。请诊断并修复。
questions.questionEn: A Spark job joining a 2 TB fact table to a 50 GB dimension table has one straggler task running 100x longer than the rest. Diagnose and fix it.

questions.question: 一个 Structured Streaming 作业从 Kafka 读取数据并写入 Delta 表。集群在一个 batch 处理到一半时被杀掉并重启。客户会看到重复行吗？请从 checkpoint 和事务日志的层面解释。
questions.questionEn: A Structured Streaming job reads Kafka and writes to a Delta table. The cluster is killed mid-batch and restarts. Does the customer get duplicate rows? Explain at the level of the checkpoint and the transaction log.

questions.question: 什么情况下你会选择 fine-tuning，而不是用 RAG 或 prompt engineering？如果确实要微调，是选 LoRA 还是全量微调？
questions.questionEn: When would you fine-tune instead of using RAG or prompt engineering, and if you do, LoRA or full fine-tuning?

sources.title: AI 工程讲解：LLM、RAG、MCP、Agent、微调、量化

questions.question: 要把一个已经能跑通的 GenAI agent 原型在企业中上线。从 demo 到正式发布之间，你的检查清单是什么？
questions.questionEn: Take a working GenAI agent prototype to production for an enterprise. What's your checklist between demo and launch?

questions.question: 客户坚持要用他们的客服工单微调一个开源模型，理由是“我们想要自己的模型”。而你认为 RAG 就能解决。你会怎么做？
questions.questionEn: A customer insists on fine-tuning an open model on their support tickets because “we want our own model.” You think RAG solves it. What do you do?

questions.question: 你四个月前上线的 agent 依赖的基座模型将在 60 天后下线。你如何在不造成质量回退的前提下替换模型？为此事先必须具备哪些条件？
questions.questionEn: An agent you shipped four months ago runs on a base model being deprecated in 60 days. How do you swap the model without regressing quality, and what had to be in place beforehand?
